about.title: About
about.shortBio: Full Stack Web & Mobile Developer working with React, Next.js, React Native, Expo and Node.js. My goal is not simply to write code, but to build products that solve real business problems.
about.longBio: I build modern websites, web applications, mobile apps, backend systems, Telegram bots and digital products for businesses. I work across frontend, backend and mobile, and I am taking my own products and services to the international market. I grew as a developer through real projects rather than theory.
about.workStyle: I don't treat a project as only frontend or only backend. I understand the full Idea → Design → Development → Backend → Mobile/Web → Deployment → Business chain and take it as far as I can on my own.
